value.signature: fn validate (root : & Path , templates : & [Rendering] , datasets : & BTreeMap < String , Dataset >) -> Result < () >

review.body: { let documents : BTreeSet < _ > = templates . iter () . map (| item | item . document . clone ()) . collect () ; let authored = markdown (root) ? ; if let Some (path) = authored . difference (& documents) . next () { return Err (format ! ("{path}: first-party Markdown has no template") . into ()) ; } let records : BTreeSet < _ > = documents . iter () . filter (| path | record (path)) . cloned () . collect () ; let mut indexed = BTreeSet :: new () ; if let Some (dataset) = datasets . get ("org.peer-network.records.index") { for row in & dataset . rows { let path = row . get ("path") . and_then (serde_json :: Value :: as_str) . ok_or ("records index: missing path") ? ; if ! indexed . insert (path . to_owned ()) { return Err (format ! ("{path}: duplicate record index row") . into ()) ; } } } if let Some (path) = records . difference (& indexed) . next () { return Err (format ! ("{path}: record template has no index row") . into ()) ; } if let Some (path) = indexed . difference (& records) . next () { return Err (format ! ("{path}: index row has no record template") . into ()) ; } for template in templates . iter () . filter (| template | record (& template . document)) { if ! template . datasets . iter () . any (| name | name == "org.peer-network.records.index") { return Err (format ! ("{}: record rendering did not read its own index row" , template . document) . into ()) ; } } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-documents decision for census::validate.
